summary: Fixed three bugs: ragged stat-card heights on Overview, a Videos topic filter that missed 12 of 27 categories, and a Videos search box that kept old text. Added one idea from Monday's trend check.
why: Screenshots showed uneven stat cards on desktop and phone; reading the Videos page found its topic list was fixed in code while history has 27 categories. All checks pass (56 smoke tests).

findings.title: Stat cards uneven
findings.detail: A wrapped label made one card taller than its neighbours.

findings.title: Topic filter missed categories
findings.detail: savings, loans, investing, salary, wealth, net_worth and 6 more couldn't be picked.

changes.title: Stat cards share one height
